rows.name: Personal crime prevalence (CSEW open data table)
rows.semantic_limit: Survey prevalence by offence and demographic groups is aggregate victimisation context; it is not a parcel incident count or direct parcel safety score.

rows.name: Personal crime incidence (CSEW open data table)
rows.semantic_limit: Survey incidence estimates are aggregate QA context and cannot be spatially assigned to individual parcels.

rows.name: Household crime prevalence (CSEW open data table)
rows.semantic_limit: Household survey prevalence supports national aggregate reconciliation only; no household or parcel identity is retained.

rows.name: Household crime incidence (CSEW open data table)
rows.semantic_limit: Household incidence is aggregate survey evidence; methodology changes and revision history must be respected and no parcel attribution is allowed.

rows.name: Perceptions criminal justice system (CSEW open data table)
rows.semantic_limit: Perceptions of institutions are attitudinal survey context and must not be converted into parcel risk or incident evidence.

rows.name: Perceptions other (CSEW open data table)
rows.semantic_limit: Public perceptions and attitudes remain separate context; they are not observed parcel-level safety outcomes.

rows.name: Police use of firearms statistics, April 2025 to March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Force-level armed operations and discharges are operational context only; no event is assigned to a parcel without an approved local evidence join.

rows.name: Firearm and shotgun certificates, April 2025 to March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Certificate applications, refusals, revocations and losses are licensing context; they do not identify local threat or parcel safety.

rows.name: User guide to statistics on firearm and shotgun certificates
rows.semantic_limit: Definitions, coverage, quality and revision rules only; methodology cannot create parcel evidence.

rows.name: Appendix tables: homicide in England and Wales
rows.semantic_limit: Homicide Index trends and characteristics are national aggregate QA; victim or case details are not retained or mapped to parcels.

rows.name: Nature of crime: fraud and computer misuse
rows.semantic_limit: CSEW fraud and computer-misuse characteristics are aggregate context and are not physical parcel incidents.

rows.name: Fraud and computer misuse in England and Wales: appendix tables
rows.semantic_limit: CSEW and NFIB aggregate reconciliation only; reporting channel and cyber location do not establish a parcel event.

rows.name: Nature of crime: violence
rows.semantic_limit: Survey descriptions of when, where and how violence occurred are aggregate QA and cannot be assigned to individual parcels.

rows.name: Nature of crime: criminal damage
rows.semantic_limit: Survey characteristics of criminal damage support aggregate calibration only; they are not parcel-specific damage records.

rows.name: Police use of force statistics, April 2024 to March 2025 (second edition)
rows.semantic_limit: Force tactics, injuries and person attributes are sensitive aggregate operational context; person-level fields are quarantined and no parcel scoring is permitted.

rows.name: Nature of crime tables, children aged 10 to 15 years violence
rows.semantic_limit: Child victimisation survey tables are sensitive aggregate evidence; no child/person data is retained and no parcel assignment is made.

rows.name: Crime in England and Wales: year ending March 2026 announcement
rows.semantic_limit: Future accredited release announcement only; no figures are inferred or used before publication.

rows.name: Crime outcomes in England and Wales 2025 to 2026 announcement
rows.semantic_limit: Future official release announcement only; no outcome figures are inferred before publication and no parcel attribution is permitted.
